turn1.explanation: Responds to faces of small, furry, pointy-eared mammals such as cats, foxes, red pandas, lynx, ferrets and hamsters, with fluffy fur texture and alert upright ears. It is suppressed by flat-faced, short-haired dogs (pugs, mastiffs, boxers) and by birds.
turn1.evidence: The top 20 are almost all cats, foxes, red pandas, a lynx, a meerkat and a ferret, plus a fluffy sheltie; the one outlier is a red car (#5), likely a weak color match. The most negative photos are pugs, bulldog/mastiff types, a hairless dog, and perched birds, which are near-neighbour animals lacking the fluffy, pointy-eared, feline/vulpine face.
